tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: You asked me to pay Evergreen Catering's approved invoice, but two are approved: INV-54311 ($1,794.66, due 2026-11-04) and INV-64706 ($5,952.39, due 2026-11-25). (INV-26736 is already paid and INV-43342 is still a draft.) Which one should I pay by wire, or should I pay both?

trace.question: You asked me to pay Evergreen Catering's approved invoice, but two are approved: INV-54311 ($1,794.66, due 2026-11-04) and INV-64706 ($5,952.39, due 2026-11-25). (INV-26736 is already paid and INV-43342 is still a draft.) Which one should I pay by wire, or should I pay both?

trace.message: Pay INV-64706, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Evergreen Catering invoice INV-64706 once, in full, by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment:** PAY0001, $5,952.39, status "sent"
- **Invoice:** INV-64706, due 2026-11-25

Evergreen had two approved invoices, so I asked you which to pay. You picked INV-64706 and told me the other approved one, INV-54311 ($1,794.66), is under dispute, so I didn't pay it. Before paying, I checked that there were no earlier payments from the operating account. I also attached a unique key to the wire so a retry can't send it twice. The payment was under the $10,000 limit, so it didn't need the controller's approval.
